verseText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
meaning: These are two reasons to praise God: he is good and he loves us with a steadfast, never-stopping kind of love.

recall.question: Our good God loves us with a never-stopping love. What should that make us do?
choices: Whine and complain about what we don't have
Obey him so He will love us more

meaning.question: God’s “loving devotion” is His never-ending love. What does it mean that this love “endures forever”?
choices: He'll love us as long as we are good
He might stop loving us someday

application.prompt: God's love is not the kind of love that changes from day to day. His love is a great big, never-ending love that will not give up on us. Think of one way God has shown His goodness to you, and thank Him for it.
